worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14044606/assets/b593a1b60fe8c1aef2c5c229ff426db350e6296b9ecb767494283f0fa3342072.png)

The chain rule for a multivariable function $f(x,y,z)$ with two independent variables $s$ and $t,$ where $x=x(s,t),y=y(s,t)$ and $z=z(s,t),$ can be expressed as follows:

$$
\frac{∂f}{∂t}=\frac{∂f}{∂x}\cdot \frac{∂x}{∂t}+\frac{∂f}{∂y}\cdot \frac{∂y}{∂t}+\frac{∂f}{∂z}\cdot \frac{∂z}{∂t}
$$

First, we find the partial derivatives of $f$ with respect to $x,y$ and $z:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x}=yz,\,\frac{∂f}{∂y}=xz,\,\frac{∂f}{∂z}=xy.\end{aligned}
$$

Writing the above results in terms of $s$ and $t,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} & =ts{e}^{t+s}, \\ \frac{∂f}{∂y} & =2t{e}^{s}, \\ \frac{∂f}{∂z} & =2s{e}^{t}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we take the derivatives of $x,$ $y,$ and $z$ with respect to $t,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂x}{∂t} & =0, \\ \frac{∂y}{∂t} & =s{e}^{t}, \\ \frac{∂z}{∂t} & ={e}^{s}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting all of our derivatives into the multivariable chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂t} & =(ts{e}^{t+s})\cdot 0+(2t{e}^{s})\cdot s{e}^{t}+(2s{e}^{t})\cdot {e}^{s} \\  & =2ts{e}^{t+s}+2s{e}^{t+s} \\  & =2s(t+1){e}^{t+s}.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 20
?

Let f(x,y,z)=xyz, where x=2, y=set and z=tes. Calculate ∂f∂t.

a
2t(s+1)et+s
b
2s(t+1)et+s
c
4t(s−1)et+s
d
4(t−s)et+s
e
2(t+s)et+s
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The chain rule for a multivariable function f(x,y,z) with two independent variables s and t, where x=x(s,t),y=y(s,t) and z=z(s,t), can be expressed as follows: ∂f∂t=∂f∂x⋅∂x∂t+∂f∂y⋅∂y∂t+∂f∂z⋅∂z∂t

First, we find the partial derivatives of f with respect to x,y and z: ∂f∂x=yz,∂f∂y=xz,∂f∂z=xy.

Writing the above results in terms of s and t, we get ∂f∂x=tset+s,∂f∂y=2tes,∂f∂z=2set.

Next, we take the derivatives of x, y, and z with respect to t, and we get ∂x∂t=0,∂y∂t=set,∂z∂t=es.

Substituting all of our derivatives into the multivariable chain rule, we get

∂f∂t=(tset+s)⋅0+(2tes)⋅set+(2set)⋅es=2tset+s+2set+s=2s(t+1)et+s.
